info.title: MANTIS API
info.description:
MANTIS API.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints require a valid **Bearer token**.

### Step 1 — Obtain an access token

Send a **POST** request to **`/authentication/token`** with:

```json
{
  "userId": "user@sts.my",
  "accessKey": "<your-access-key>"
}
```

**Example response (200 OK):**

```json
{
  "accessToken": "<jwt-token>",
  "expiredDate": "2026-01-01 12:00:00"
}
```

### Step 2 — Authorize in Swagger UI

1. Call **POST /authentication/token** and copy the `accessToken`.
2. Click **Authorize** (lock icon).
3. Paste the `accessToken` into **BearerAuth** and click **Authorize**.

### Using the token with external clients

```
Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
```

## Swagger sample cap (all list endpoints)

**Try it out from this page** is detected via the `Referer` header (`/swagger`). Each list in the JSON is capped at **20 sample rows** so the UI does not lag. The body includes `sample: true`, `fromSwagger: true`, `totalCount` (or `totalCounts`), and a `message`. curl, the operations frontend, and MCP receive the **full** result. `POST /authentication/token` and `GET /` (health) are not sampled.

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token from **POST /authentication/token**. Enter the `accessToken` value only (Swagger adds the `Bearer` prefix).

accessKey.description: The access key given to the user.

polygon.description: Closed polygon ring as a list of [longitude, latitude] points.

lastSeenAt.description: Last AIS position timestamp for this vessel (`tscurrent` / `ais_position.ts`). Use as the anchor for GET /mantis/vessel-track — not pairedAt, which is pipeline wall clock on STS.

imo.description: Normalized 7-digit IMO from ais_static, if present.

toBow.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to bow. Class A from ais_static, else Class B from ais_staticb.

toStern.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to stern.

toPort.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to port.

toStarboard.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to starboard.

lengthM.description: Overall length in metres (toBow + toStern). Null if either offset is missing.

beamM.description: Beam (width) in metres (toPort + toStarboard). Null if either offset is missing.

sanctionsMatch.description: True if this vessel matches OFAC SDN or consolidated non-SDN. Label only — not a legal finding and not used in suspicion_score.

matchConfidence.description: confirmed = IMO match. possible = MMSI match when the candidate has no IMO. none = no match. Unmatched vessels are still returned.

durationSeconds.description: How long the cluster has been open.

pairedAt.description: Pipeline wall clock when the cluster was last updated (`last_detected_at`). Not AIS time — use vessel lastSeenAt for /mantis/vessel-track.

firstDetectedAt.description: When the proximity cluster was first opened.

sanctionsMatch.description: True if vesselA or vesselB matches OFAC. Does not change suspicionScore.

matchConfidence.description: Best of the two vessels (confirmed > possible > none).

openHighScoreCount.description: Active (is_open) clusters meeting the suspicion score threshold (all areas).

inAnchorageClusterCount.description: High-score open clusters whose centroid is inside a parent / watch polygon and not inside an Excl hole.

pairCount.description: Pairs within maxDistanceM belonging to those clusters.

pairedVesselCount.description: Vessels that appear in pairs (map markers).

sanctionsMatchPairCount.description: Pairs where at least one vessel matches OFAC.

tsCurrent.description: Last AIS fix on the movement activity (`tscurrent`). Same instant as lastSeenAt.

lastSeenAt.description: Last AIS position timestamp (`tscurrent`). Use as the anchor for GET /mantis/vessel-track — not detectedAt, which is API wall clock.

inPortLimit.description: True if the last position is inside an Excl carve-out (hole). Returned candidates are already filtered so this is typically false.

portLimitName.description: Name of the Excl hole if the position was inside one. Returned candidates are already filtered so this is typically null.

toBow.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to bow. Class A from ais_static, else Class B from ais_staticb.

toStern.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to stern.

toPort.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to port.

toStarboard.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to starboard.

lengthM.description: Overall length in metres (toBow + toStern). Null if either offset is missing.

beamM.description: Beam (width) in metres (toPort + toStarboard). Null if either offset is missing.

sanctionsMatch.description: True if this vessel matches OFAC. Label only — AIS keep/drop rules are unchanged.

portLimitPolygonCount.description: Count of Excl carve-out polygons (API key kept for compatibility).

sanctionsMatchCount.description: Candidates that match OFAC. Unmatched vessels are still returned.

tsCurrent.description: Last AIS fix on the slow-move activity (`tscurrent`). Same instant as lastSeenAt.

lastSeenAt.description: Last AIS position timestamp (`tscurrent`). Use as the anchor for GET /mantis/vessel-track.

polygonName.description: Name of the polygon containing the last position. If inside both a parent and an Excl hole, the Excl name is used. Null when outside all anchorage polygons. Candidates are never dropped by polygon.

inExclPolygon.description: True when the last position is inside an Excl carve-out. Label only — the vessel is still returned.

toBow.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to bow. Class A from ais_static, else Class B from ais_staticb.

toStern.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to stern.

toPort.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to port.

toStarboard.description: Metres from AIS GPS antenna to starboard.

lengthM.description: Overall length in metres (toBow + toStern). Null if either offset is missing.

beamM.description: Beam (width) in metres (toPort + toStarboard). Null if either offset is missing.

sanctionsMatch.description: True if this vessel matches OFAC. Label only — not used in dark confidence and candidates are not dropped.

sanctionsMatchCount.description: Candidates that match OFAC. Unmatched vessels are still returned.

lastAisAt.description: Last AIS position timestamp (`ais_position.ts`). AIS time, not wall clock.

detectedAt.description: AIS event time for this identity: `lastAisAt` if present, else `identityAt`.

sanctionsMatch.description: True if this identity matches OFAC. Label only — groups are not dropped.

detectedAt.description: Latest AIS timestamp among the identities (position.ts, else static.ts). Not the API wall clock.

firstAisAt.description: Earliest AIS timestamp among the identities.

maxInternalDistanceM.description: Greatest pairwise distance of last known positions. Null if fewer than two positions.

sanctionsMatch.description: True if any identity in the group matches OFAC.

matchConfidence.description: Best OFAC confidence among the identities.

sanctionsMatchGroupCount.description: Groups where any identity matches OFAC. Unmatched groups are still returned.

identities.description: Flat list of identities for map markers (same objects as nested under groups).

reason.description: teleport = long impossible jump; high_speed = implied speed > 80 kn on a shorter gap.

eventDay.description: UTC calendar day of the anomaly fix (dedupe key).

detectedAt.description: AIS timestamp of the anomaly fix — not API wall clock.

lastSeenAt.description: Same as detectedAt; anchor for GET /mantis/vessel-track.

rawHitCount.description: Consecutive fix pairs flagged before ship-type filter.

filteredHitCount.description: Pairs after cargo/tanker filter, before dedupe.

anomalyCount.description: Rows after dedupe (one per MMSI per UTC day).

imo.description: Normalized IMO used for the search, if provided.

mmsi.description: Normalized MMSI used for the search, if provided.

totalCount.description: Rows matching the filter (before Swagger sample cap).

returnedCount.description: Rows in `vessels`. 20 when this call is from Swagger UI and the list is larger.

sample.description: True when the payload was capped for Swagger UI.

fromSwagger.description: True when the request Referer is the Swagger page.

message.description: Explains the 20-row sample when `sample` is true.

eventEnd.description: Event end time for segment-style activities; null for point events.

eventType.description: Event category, e.g. ZONE_VISIT, STOPPED, SLOW_SPEED, SHIPNAME_CHANGED.

details.description: Source-specific metadata (zone id, nav status, previous/new values, etc.).

durationSeconds.description: Elapsed time between first and last track point.

toOmitted.description: True when the client did not send `to`; range is from + 3 days.

rangeCapped.description: True when the requested span was longer than 3 days and `to` was clamped.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.

requestBody.description: Credentials required to obtain a token.

get.description:
v1 heuristic over `ais_vesselslowmoveactivities`: Class-A large vessels (shipType 70–89) that slowed then went silent before a confirmed stop (`rowcount < 30`), with AIS silence ≥ 30 minutes. Reasons: `suspected_dark_after_slowdown` (higher interest), `possible_coverage_exit` (SEA footprint leave), `low_evidence_ais_gap`. Not proof of intentional dark — see `backend/mantis-detection.md`. Candidates are labeled with `polygonName` when the last position is inside a polygon from `polygons.py` (Excl name preferred if inside a hole). They are not dropped by polygon. OFAC SDN/CONS is attached as `sanctionsMatch` / `matchConfidence` (IMO = confirmed, MMSI-only = possible). Unmatched vessels stay. Listed ships are sorted first; dark `confidence` is unchanged.

**This Swagger page:** `vessels` is capped at 20 samples.

parameters.name: includeCoverageExit
parameters.description: When false, exclude `possible_coverage_exit` rows (tighter ops list).

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.

get.summary: Search the OFAC vessel list (IMO or MMSI).
get.description:
Returns OFAC **vessels** from `pnav` (SDN plus consolidated non-SDN if loaded). This is a lookup of the ingested list, not a MANTIS detector and not a legal finding.

- Pass `imo` and/or `mmsi` to search (either identifier matches).
- If neither is passed, the **full vessel list** is returned (~1,500 SDN ships).
- **Swagger UI Try it out** is capped at **20 sample rows** so the page does not lag. `sample` is true and `message` explains this. `totalCount` is still the full match count.
- curl, the frontend, and MCP receive the entire result.

People and companies on SDN are not included (no IMO/MMSI).

parameters.name: mmsi
parameters.description: MMSI. Optional. If both imo and mmsi are set, a row matching either is returned.

200.description: OFAC vessel rows. From Swagger UI, at most 20 rows plus a sample message.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.

get.summary: Get all anchorage polygons (including restricted limit).
get.description:
Returns every anchorage area polygon defined in `polygons.py`, plus the **Restricted Limit** polygon. Polygons whose name contains **Excl** are carve-outs (holes) inside a parent polygon and are included in this catalogue. Coordinates are GeoJSON-ordered `[longitude, latitude]`.

**Clients (curl / frontend):** a JSON array of all polygons.
**This Swagger page:** an object with `polygons` (first 20), `sample`, `totalCount`, and `message`.

200.description: Full polygon catalogue (array) for curl/frontend. From this Swagger page: object with 20 sample polygons.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.

get.summary: Get active high-suspicion STS pairs inside anchorage polygons.
get.description:
Returns vessel pairs from **active** (`is_open = true`) proximity clusters with **high suspicion_score** (default ≥ 4.5) whose centroid falls inside a parent / watch polygon. Clusters whose centroid is inside an **Excl** carve-out (hole) are excluded. Pairs are recomputed at ≤ **35 m**. Each vessel includes **`lastSeenAt`** (AIS time of the fix used for that member). **`pairedAt`** is pipeline wall clock only — use `lastSeenAt` with GET /mantis/vessel-track. OFAC labels (`sanctionsMatch`) are attached per vessel; `suspicionScore` is unchanged. Listed pairs are sorted first.

**This Swagger page:** `pairs` and `pairedVessels` are each capped at 20 samples.

200.description: Active high-suspicion STS pairs inside anchorages.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.

get.description:
v3 heuristic using stopped/stale **Class-A large vessels** only (AIS `shipType` 70–89). KEEP vessels inside the **restricted-limit** polygon and/or **parent / watch polygons** from `polygons.py`. EXCLUDE vessels inside any **Excl** carve-out (a hole inside a parent polygon, e.g. Singapore South Anchorage Excl1). Parent polygons such as Singapore East / Western OPL / South are used as watch zones. OFAC labels (`sanctionsMatch`) are attached; keep/drop rules are unchanged. Not a legal determination.

**This Swagger page:** `vessels` is capped at 20 samples.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.

get.description:
Groups of Class-A cargo/tanker MMSIs (`shipType` 70–89) that resolve to **one hull** (re-flag, dual identity). Match rule: IMO plus name/callsign/dimensions, or name plus callsign/dimensions. Placeholder IMOs such as 1234567 are ignored. `detectedAt` is the **latest AIS timestamp** in the group (`ais_position.ts`, else `ais_static.ts`) — not the API wall clock. OFAC labels (`sanctionsMatch`) are attached per identity and rolled up on the group; unmatched groups are kept. Listed groups are sorted first.

Optional `maxDistanceM` keeps only groups whose last positions are still that close.

**This Swagger page:** `groups` and `identities` are each capped at 20 samples.

parameters.name: maxDistanceM
parameters.description: If set, keep only groups whose last-known positions are closer than this (metres). Groups without two positions are dropped.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.

get.description:
Also referred to as **GET /mantis/position-anomaly** in product docs — that path is **not** served; use **`/mantis/spoofing`**.

Phase 1 scans ClickHouse `ais_position` for impossible movement between consecutive AIS fixes on the same MMSI (teleport / high implied speed). **Class-A cargo/tanker only** (`shipType` 70–89 from latest `ais_static`). Results are **deduped to one row per MMSI per UTC day** (worst implied speed that day). `detectedAt` / `lastSeenAt` are the AIS time of the anomaly fix.

Optional `from` / `to` (ISO 8601 UTC) — same **3-day max** window as GET /mantis/vessel-track. OFAC labels attached; listed vessels sorted first.

**This Swagger page:** `anomalies` is capped at 20 samples.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Window start (UTC). Default: 3 days before effective `to`.

400.description: Invalid date range (e.g. from after to).

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.

get.summary: Get derived activity timeline for one vessel.
get.description:
Returns discrete activity/events for a vessel between two datetimes from PostgreSQL derived tables: zone visits (`ais_vesselinzone`), restricted zone visits (`ais_vesselinrestrictzone`), stop/low-speed activities (`ais_vesselmovementactivities`), slow-move activities (`ais_vesselslowmoveactivities`), and static identity changes (`ais_static_evt`). Does not include raw AIS position points — use **GET /mantis/vessel-track** for full track replay.

**This Swagger page:** `events` is capped at 20 samples.

parameters.name: mmsi
parameters.description: Maritime Mobile Service Identity of the vessel.

200.description: Ordered list of derived vessel activity events.

400.description: Missing/invalid query parameters or date range.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.

get.summary: Get AIS track for map replay (streamed).
get.description:
Returns ordered AIS position reports for one vessel from ClickHouse (`pnav.ais_position`, optionally `pnav.ais_type18` for Class B).

**Only `mmsi` is required.** `to` defaults to the current UTC datetime; `from` defaults to 3 days before the effective `to`, so passing neither returns the **last 3 days**. If `from` is given without `to`, `to` is the current datetime unless `from` + 3 days is earlier, in which case the window ends there and `rangeCapped` is true. A requested span longer than 3 days is clamped to `from` + 3 days.

**Only plottable fixes are returned.** Raw AIS encodes "position not available" as latitude 91 / longitude 181; those rows are filtered in ClickHouse (`latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180`, which also drops NaN / ±Inf). A vessel that never reported a position returns `pointCount: 0`. Note that `sog` 102.3, `cog` 360 and `trueHeading` 511 are the equivalent "unavailable" markers for those fields and are passed through unchanged.

**curl / frontend / Dash:** NDJSON stream. ClickHouse is read in **20-minute** windows; each window is flushed as a `chunk` line as soon as it returns so the map can start drawing. Empty windows are skipped.

**This Swagger page:** JSON sample of the first 20 points (not a live stream).

parameters.name: mmsi
parameters.description: Maritime Mobile Service Identity of the vessel.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Range start (ISO 8601, UTC recommended). Optional. Defaults to 3 days before the effective `to`, so omitting both gives the last 3 days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Range end (ISO 8601, UTC recommended). Optional. Defaults to the current UTC datetime, or `from` + 3 days when that is earlier. Spans longer than 3 days are clamped to 3 days.

parameters.name: includeClassB
parameters.description: When true, include Class B positions from `pnav.ais_type18` merged with Class A.

200.description: NDJSON stream for real clients (meta, then 20-minute chunks, then done). Swagger Try it out returns a JSON sample of the first 20 points.

schema.description: One JSON object per line. Types: meta, chunk, done, error.

400.description: Missing/invalid query parameters or date range.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token.
